name.en: Smartwatch with GPS and Heart Rate Monitor, Black Aluminum Case and Sport Band, Bluetooth, Sleep and Blood Oxygen Tracking, 100+ Workout Modes, Water-Resistant to 50 m, 7-Day Battery

description.en: A light aluminum smartwatch that tracks runs with built-in GPS, heart rate and sleep. Notifications arrive over Bluetooth, and one charge lasts about a week.
